label: PF Backlog 193
title: Backend: run-mode-aware quality gate (item/amend runs run compileall+wired_audit; e2e skips)
body:
## Problem / why
The repo quality gate (`compileall` + `wired_audit`: store-registry, unwired, diff-contract,
destructive, reciprocity, tier-models, agent-knowledge, legacy-frozen) runs only in CI / the PR
merge gate (`core/pr_gate.py`). When a human executes a BACKLOG ITEM as a run (scoped amend), that
gate is what is really needed - but it never runs on the run path. A full e2e pipeline run does NOT
need it (per-agent compliance already runs for every agent).

## Goal & value
A run carries a MODE. `item`/amend runs execute the repo quality gate and record pass/fail on the
run; `e2e` runs skip it. Reuse existing primitives: `run_scope` (only_stages/only_agents) and
`core/pr_gate.py` (which already invokes wired_audit).

## In scope
- A `mode` (e2e | item) on the run (run-scope / run record).
- For `item` mode: run compileall + the wired_audit subset (or pr_gate) and store the result
  (pass/fail + reasons) on the run; do not gate e2e.
- Expose the gate result for the dashboard to read.

## Out of scope
- Per-agent compliance (already runs in BOTH modes). Dashboard UI (separate dashboard item).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- item-mode run records `quality_gate: {passed, reasons}`; e2e run records it as skipped/absent.
- A failing gate on an item run is surfaced (and can block the run per policy).

## Open questions
- Block the item run on gate failure, or report-only?
- Full wired_audit (fatal checks) or only the relevant subset (store/diff/legacy)?

## Verification / test plan
- Run an item-scoped run with a deliberately broken store -> gate fails + recorded; e2e run unaffected.

dashboard_impact.reason: Enables the dashboard 'Run item' flow to enforce the repo quality gate.

_note: core/run_quality_gate.py (single writer of quality-gate.json): should_gate(mode), mode_from_scope, evaluate() [compileall + wired_audit subprocess], record(), latest(), gate_if_item_run(). Wired into core/pipeline_executor.py at run end: mode = 'item' when a selective run-scope (only_stages/only_agents) is set, else 'e2e'; item/amend runs run the gate + record quality-gate.json, e2e skips. Store registered. VERIFIED: e2e -> None (skipped); item -> gate ran (passed) + quality-gate.json recorded; latest() reads it. Dashboard half = BI-0137 (paired, not implemented). compileall=0, wired_audit=0, run_quality_gate=RUNTIME.
